name: PicPak client
description: Battery-powered PicPak 4.2" 4-colour BWRY e-paper frame. Wakes on a timer, pulls the current frame over REST (or MQTT), paints the 400x300 panel via SPI, publishes a battery / RSSI heartbeat, and deep-sleeps. Reads its sleep-interval config from the server. Firmware: https://github.com/varanu5/picpak-tesserae-client

sleep_interval_s.label: Sleep interval
sleep_interval_s.help: How long the frame sleeps between fetches. Longer intervals extend battery life; typical dashboards use 15 to 60 minutes. Custom value is in seconds.
